description: This file contains a JUnit test class named ClassSourcerTest that tests the source code generation of Java classes from bytecode using ASM's ClassReader and a custom ClassSourcer. It includes setup for different class scenarios such as base class, inner class, and template class, asserting that the generated source matches expected stub code.
